title: EIP-1967 proxy admin slot
detects: The address permitted to upgrade this proxy. This is the party who can replace the token's entire logic.
knownFalseNegative: An empty admin slot does not mean nobody can upgrade. Legacy and UUPS proxies keep upgrade rights elsewhere, and a beacon proxy's authority is on the beacon.

coversExamples.observed: admin slot probed alongside the zeppelinos implementation slot

rationale: Upgradeability without knowing WHO can upgrade is only half the finding. This turns 'is a proxy' into 'and this address controls it'.
